identity.mission: Create a 'Cyber-Organic' interface that blends cold AI precision with warm human tactility.
principles: Glass is Structure, not Decoration: Use blur for hierarchy, not just aesthetics.
The 'Human' Touch: Use Beige/Flesh tones for success states and user avatars to ground the tech.
Neon is Function: Fuchsia indicates 'AI Action', Blue indicates 'System Status'.
Deep Void: Backgrounds are never flat black; they are deep, infinite midnight (#030014).

strategies.mode_logic: Dark Mode First. Light mode exists only as a 'Day Mode' toggle for long reading, but the default is 'Night/Cyber'.

usage.fuchsia: Primary Actions, AI Insights, Active States

glass_card.name: GlassCard
glass_card.classes: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl transition-all hover:bg-white/10 hover:border-white/20
glass_card.best_practice: Use for Lesson Modules, Dashboard Widgets. Always add a subtle inner glow.

neon_button.name: NeonButton
neon_button.classes: group relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-600 px-8 py-4 font-semibold text-white transition-all hover:bg-fuchsia-500 hover:shadow-[0_0_40px_-10px_rgba(217,70,239,0.5)] active:scale-95
neon_button.best_practice: Primary CTA. The shadow is crucial for the 'Neon' feel.

split_view.name: SplitLayout
split_view.classes: grid h-screen grid-cols-1 overflow-hidden md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_400px] xl:grid-cols-[1fr_600px]
split_view.best_practice: Left: Learning Content (Scrollable). Right: AI Sandbox (Fixed, Glass Panel).

progress_bar.name: CyberProgress
progress_bar.indicator_classes: h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-fuchsia-500 transition-all duration-500 ease-out

layout_strategies.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6

visual_enhancers.noise_overlay: pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 h-full w-full opacity-[0.03] bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]
visual_enhancers.glow_blobs: absolute -top-40 -right-40 h-[500px] w-[500px] rounded-full bg-fuchsia-600/20 blur-[100px]

universal_guidelines: Never use solid black (#000000) for backgrounds. Use #030014.
Text on glass must be White (Primary) or Slate-300 (Secondary). Never use Gray-500 on glass.
Input fields should be 'bg-white/5 border-white/10' with 'focus:border-fuchsia-500'.
Use 'Flesh/Beige' colors for User Avatar borders and 'Success' states to add warmth.
All interactive elements must have 'data-testid' attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the custom colors (void, fuchsia, beige).
3. Create a global 'Glass' utility class in index.css.
4. Build the 'Lesson View' first as it's the core USP (Split view).
5. Use the 'Noise Overlay' on the body to give texture.
6. Ensure the 'AI Sandbox' has a code-editor feel (JetBrains Mono).
